summary: Canaan Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 19, 2026, containing its Q1 2026 earnings press release. No special-situation event is present; the filing solely reports routine financial results, including revenue of $62.7 million, a record crypto treasury of 1,807.60 BTC and 3,951.53 ETH, and the acquisition of a 49% interest in ABC Projects from Cipher Mining. This acquisition is a minor operational investment, not a transformative deal or divestiture. The filing is a standard periodic report with no board recommendation, deal terms, or other special-situation triggers. As a foreign private issuer filing a 6-K, this maps to a US 8-K earnings release.
